name: Smedmore Caravan Site
stayType: Caravan and motorhome site on a private estate
accommodation: 40 large pitches for caravans and motorhomes (no tents mentioned)
suitableFor: Caravanners and motorhomers who are self-contained
beachAccess: Walk to Kimmeridge Bay along the coast path from the site
confirmedFeatures: Electric hook-ups, Wi-Fi, two water points, chemical disposal point; no toilets or showers; Caravan Club and Motorhome Club affiliated; open May to October
overview: A caravan-only site on the private Smedmore estate at Kimmeridge, with 40 large pitches arranged around the field edge. There are hook-ups and Wi-Fi but no toilet or shower block, and Kimmeridge Bay can be reached on foot via the coast path.
surfTripFit: About as close as you can stay to the Kimmeridge ledges, with a coast-path walk down to the bay; best for self-contained vans.
